func (m *concurrentClient) notifyCancellation(call *concurrentHostCall) {
 <-call.sent
 m.mu.Lock()
 live := m.calls[call.id] == call && !m.stopping && (!m.draining || call.cleanup) && m.terminal == nil
 m.mu.Unlock()
 if live {
  if _, err := m.transport.write(Frame{Protocol: ProtocolVersion, ID: call.id, Type: "call", Identity: m.client.binding.Identity, Method: "transport.cancel", Payload: json.RawMessage(`null`)}, nil); err != nil { m.abort(err) }
 }
}
